behaviors.description: Preinstall a vendor app from independent sideload data while remote payload transfers are blocked.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent signed collection, actionable app definition, installed runtime, absent app and app-only offline source.
behaviors.expected: Ordinary preinstall attempts a blocked transfer and preserves state; the sideload option installs the exact signed app without remote payload requests.

mappings.rationale: A blocked-download control and independent exact commits distinguish sideload use from cached or remotely downloaded content.

surface_assertions.rationale: The offline source enables exact vendor app deployment after ordinary network-dependent synchronization fails.
